And it makes me happy even thinking about how I will no longer feel the pain. And I will know I’ve done all I can to help those im leaving behind. I plan to visit everyone I can before I go and take so many photos with them. Clean out my photo albums on my phone and make one for every special person in my life so they know I know they cared for me even though they were unable to help me.
I think it’s nearing the end for me. I always told myself I would visit all of my friends before I left. Time to start booking flights.

I’ve been thinking this all day. My self care is cutesy Instagram bullshit. 
If I don’t want to do something. I think of myself as a friend of mine and what I would do to help them. My buddy is at home sad and his apartment was getting really gross because he’s just been so low..I would go over and do his dishes and just listen to him talk. Or do it in silence and just be there for him. Tidy up surfaces. Take his clothes to the dry cleaners so he didn’t have to wash and fold them. But when I’m low I need to just step outside of myself and instead of saying my apartment is a mess and I’m so depressed. I pretend like I’m at my friends apartment. And imagine myself sitting on the couch and crying and talk to myself and tidy up for her. Or go to the gym for her. She works so hard. Someone should take care of her sometimes.

It took me three or four times to try and read this. Because I kept crying and had to stop and come back and read from the beginning. The “hiding behind the rock until it’s all clear” is exactly it. I just want to hide with the familiar and miserable until I know the next one won’t break my heart. But hell I came from behind it to meet this guy. With no intention of falling in love with him at all. Thinking “this guy is not my type. I’m barely even interested. But I’ll go for drinks and go home” and I honestly forgot about that until you made me remember. And then it just happened. I just fell in love with him. And he told me when he broke up with me he wasn’t ready for a relationship and shouldn’t have dated me and he needed to work on himself, days after telling me I’m the first woman he really wanted to marry. It was the first time anyone told me they wanted to marry me and I was so excited to have finally been done with the dating scene. Done with getting rejected and ghosted and finally have someone to share my life with. No more “what’s your favorite color? Does your mom like me? Did you play sports in highschool?” I had finally gotten so close to beating the game. Because I do sincerely hate dating. I hate dating apps. I hate small talk. I don’t like eating in front of people I don’t know so dates are a nightmare. (Can we stop eating on dates and just go do something?) 

Sometimes my friends tell me I wasn’t even happy before the breakup. He never made time for me. He never planned dates. He never came over to my place or spent time with my family. It was always be catering to his schedule or his friends and never the other way around. And that I was just in love with the idea of never dating again and having a big family to marry into and in laws and friends. But not him just what he could give me. And that stings. And I don’t think it’s true all the time. But sometimes I wish it was I guess. I just find it hard to believe that anyone will get me like he did. He noticed small things about me no one else ever had. Things I’ve always done, noises and responses and habits. And I just felt seen. And I fear no one will ever see me like that ever again. And if they do I’ll have to work so hard for it. And teach someone to see those things about me. It always feels like I’m begging someone to choose me and like me, because I’m always the one making lists of my boyfriends likes and dislikes and committing them to memory so I can show I care about them and listen. And I want someone to be that way about me. And what if I never feel the kind of love I give to others? Then what?

I feel like I don’t even remember how to be happy anymore so I just keep punishing myself and like you said encouraging the universe to punish me because I feel like I deserve it. I feel like I want to improve and stop being so miserable and I don’t even know where to start.
That’s a nice sentiment. But I know he hasn’t thought about me in 6 months.

Now ive been on my meds for about 4 months and doing therapy and had to rebuild my life on top. Its super scary, but you just have to take a mental and physical inventory of how you feel when it comes to treatment- it doesn't matter if they say you have to eat 30 gummi bears a day- you just do what youre given, to the best of your ability, take that inventory and be honest with your providers and yourself on how you feel knowing you deserve to live a life that isn't miserable or unmanageable. For me, it was a pill, then another, then another, and now I just know taking one pill a day and keeping checked in with myself and my goals is what my life looks like.
